postings.title: Internship - FPGA Hardware Design - PQ Cryptography Hardware Accelerator
postings.description:
Who we are

CryptoNext Security is a deeptech startup specializing in post-quantum cryptography. Our solutions help businesses and institutions prepare for a future where quantum computers will challenge traditional data security. We work with leading clients in finance, defense, and telecommunications.

About the role

As part of an exploratory project on hardware accelerators for post-quantum cryptography (PQC), we are looking for a highly motivated FPGA Hardware Design Engineer to take ownership of a key strategic project at the intersection of hardware/software codesign (FPGA development and low-level C) and post-quantum cryptographic accelerators. You will work on the design, integration, and evaluation of hardware accelerators for well-identified mathematical functions used in post-quantum cryptographic algorithms, with a strong focus on demonstrating concrete performance benefits on a real embedded platform.

Your mission

You will study state-of-the-art approaches described in the scientific literature on PQC hardware acceleration, including relevant academic work such as this recent study, and implement the selected ones. You will focus in particular on the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) and the Keccak state permutation function, two key computational functions involved in the implementation of algorithms such as ML-KEM and ML-DSA (lattice-based PQC algorithms).

You will be responsible for developing system-level RTL code using SystemVerilog, integrating the resulting accelerators into a complete hardware/software system, and evaluating their impact on application-level performance. The target platform will be an AMD Xilinx ZCU104 development board, equipped with a Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC.

The primary objective of the internship is to demonstrate, on the target platform, that a hardware accelerator for either the NTT or the Keccak permutation can effectively accelerate the corresponding ML-KEM or ML-DSA implementation in the CryptoNext Quantum Safe Library (C-QSL).

Requirements

Required skills

Must-have

- FPGA development, RTL design using Verilog, SystemVerilog or VHDL
- Experience with AMD Vivado or Intel Altera Quartus and FPGA development platforms
- Good programming skills in C under Linux, with basic knowledge of assembly language
- Strong interest in hardware/software codesign and embedded systems
- Experience with Git and standard software development workflows
- Familiarity with shell scripting, Makefiles, and compiler toolchains
- Experience using profilers and debuggers to analyze and optimize software performance
- Ability to work independently, investigate technical problems, and communicate results clearly

Nice-to-have

- Knowledge of AMBA protocols, such as AXI, AHB, APB, or CHI
- Experience with JTAG-based debugging
- Experience with QEMU, including the Xilinx fork of QEMU
- Experience with QEMU/SystemC/Verilator co-simulation
- Previous exposure to post-quantum cryptography, lattice-based cryptography, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, NTT or DFT, or Keccak (or more generally hash functions)
- Familiarity with embedded Linux and Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC architectures

Benefits

Internship details

- Duration: 6 months
- Period: December 2026 – June 2027
- Education: Final-year engineering student or M2 / Master's degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, embedded systems, microelectronics, or a related field

postings.title: Senior Cryptography Engineer - C developper
postings.description:
Who we are

CryptoNext Security is a Paris-based start-up founded in 2019, building on more than 20 years of academic research. CryptoNext is a software vendor specializing in quantum-computer-resistant cryptography (PQC: post-quantum cryptography). Its software suite, the Quantum Safe Remediation Suite, includes the world-reference Quantum Safe Library (C-QSL), covering the full selection of NIST algorithms, and helps enterprises and integrators migrate to the era of post-quantum cybersecurity.

CryptoNext Security was cited among the 5 reference leaders in Gartner’s report on post-quantum cryptography (October 2021) and received the Innovation Prize at «Les Assises 2022». CryptoNext is a member of Campus Cyber, Hexatrust and Systematic, and was selected in 2022 to join a workgroup of the US National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence (NCCoE) dedicated to PQC migration best practices.

We are looking for a highly motivated, senior Cryptography R&D Engineer to join our team and take ownership of a key strategic project: porting our post-quantum cryptographic library across multiple platforms, with a particular focus on hardware/software FPGA accelerators. This role sits at the intersection of cryptography, low-level C engineering and embedded/hardware design.

On a daily basis, you will

• Design and implement efficient C code for post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST-selected or recommended by EU agencies), balancing performance, portability and security.

• Port and optimize the CryptoNext Quantum Safe Library (C-QSL) across multiple platforms and architectures

• Adapt implementations for constrained and embedded environments (e.g., IoT, Cortex-M, embedded Linux).

• Define and run test and validation strategies (functional, performance, security) across all target platforms.

• Support security certification processes (CSPN, Common Criteria, FIPS) for the ported implementations.

• Document your work through technical reports and, where relevant, scientific papers.

• Collaborate closely with the R&D team and cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges.

The CryptoNext Quantum Safe Library is developed mainly in C and Assembly, targeting several operating systems (Linux, Windows, iOS, Android…) and processor architectures (x86, Arm, RISC-V…), as well as FPGA-based hardware accelerators.

Other tasks may include, depending on your profile and the product roadmap: work on side-channel countermeasures, and collaboration with the team in charge of integrating the library with communication protocols and cryptographic objects (TLS, IPsec, PKCS#11, X.509…) in post-quantum or hybrid mode.

Requirements

The skills you will demonstrate

• Significant, senior-level experience in cryptography engineering, ideally 5+ years, gained in a software company or department of a larger organization (cybersecurity vendor, IT application or hardware provider), ideally with international teams or clients.

• Engineering degree or Master’s in computer science, mathematics or a related field; a PhD in cryptography or a related discipline is a strong plus.

• Solid foundations in algorithmics and algebra, with the ability to translate mathematical constructs into efficient, correct implementations.

• Strong programming skills in C; comfort working close to the hardware and optimizing for performance and security.

• Comfort using embedded development and hardware debugging tools (GCC, GDB, QEMU, JTAG…) and practical experience with source code management and continuous integration using GitLab CI.

• Experience with public-key cryptography, symmetric-key cryptography, hash functions, and cryptographic protocols/frameworks such as OpenSSL is a plus.

• Experience in one or more of the following is a strong plus: embedded software development, hardware/software co-design, FPGA implementation.

• Good French & English communication skills, both oral and written.

Benefits

What's in it for you at CryptoNext

• Ownership of a strategic, high-impact technical challenge — multi-platform porting and hardware acceleration — at the heart of our product roadmap.

• A fast-growing, globally recognized deep-tech start-up, named among Gartner’s 5 reference leaders in post-quantum cryptography.

• Full-time position, based in Paris.

• Competitive salary, commensurate with experience.

postings.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript)
postings.description:
Who we are

CryptoNext Security is a deeptech startup specializing in post-quantum cryptography. Our solutions help businesses and institutions prepare for a future where quantum computers will challenge traditional data security. We work with leading clients in finance, defense, and telecommunications.

On a daily basis, you will

• Own features end to end in TypeScript: Hono and Node.js on PostgreSQL, React SPA on the front.

• Design HTTP APIs consumed through Hono's typed RPC client, with generated OpenAPI specs.

• Model and query PostgreSQL: schema, migrations, query performance.

• Build interfaces with Vite, TanStack, Tailwind and shadcn/ui.

• Work directly with Product and QA.

• Write the unit and integration tests that back your features, and give QA what they need to automate the rest.

• Review code.

• Use AI coding tools as leverage under your own judgement, staying accountable for what lands in the repo.

• Propose upgrades and refactorings, and explain the trade-offs you accepted.

How we work

A team of six engineers, within our 15-person R&D department. A single TypeScript monorepo, with shared types and tooling across services and front. Three days a week in our Paris office, the rest remote. Short feedback loops, high standards. We ship a working version early rather than polishing in isolation, and keep solutions as simple as the problem allows. Our products ship on-premise, sometimes into air-gapped environments, so builds have to be reproducible and dependencies deliberate. We build software our clients rely on for security: secure defaults, reviewed dependencies and tested code are part of shipping, not a later phase. We care more about a decision you can justify than a pattern you can name.

Requirements

The skills you'll need

• Strong TypeScript across the stack: strict mode, generics, types shared between server and client instead of duplicated.

• Node.js backend: API design, auth, error handling, observability.

• Asynchronous processing: queue consumers and background workers, idempotency, retries and failure handling, backpressure.

• PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations and rollbacks, indexing, reading a query plan.

• Strong React: hooks, composition, clear state boundaries, client-side routing and server state caching.

• Comfortable with a modern frontend toolchain: fast bundling, utility-first styling, component libraries you extend rather than fight.

• API contract design: REST, OpenAPI, typed clients, versioning.

• Unit and integration testing, with a defensible position on what belongs at which level and on what is worth testing at all.

• Real use of AI-assisted development in a production codebase: agentic workflows, context management, reviewing generated output as critically as a colleague's merge request. You have a view on where these tools pay off and where they create debt.

• Seniority means you can say why you chose an approach, what you rejected, and what it will cost in six months.

Bonus skills

• Go, used in parts of our codebase.

• Hono typed RPC and end-to-end type inference.

• Secure coding practices and application security.

• Basic understanding of cryptography and cybersecurity.

• Experience in a startup or deeptech environment.

Benefits

The team you'll be joining

You will join a team of six engineers who own their features across the whole stack, inside our 15-person R&D department, working closely with Product and QA. You will report to the Head of Engineering and collaborate with other departments to build the backend services and interfaces our clients depend on.

Our recruitment process

1. Initial discussion with our HR team to explore your background and motivations.

2. Technical interview with a developer: a live coding session of 1 to 1.5 hours. AI coding tools are required, not merely allowed. We are interested in how you direct and review them. No take-home assignment.

3. Meeting with a manager to ensure alignment with our company culture.

4. If successful, you'll receive a final offer!

What's in it for you at CryptoNext

• A stimulating work environment with cutting-edge technological challenges.

• A competitive salary, aligned with our compensation philosophy.

• A deep dive into the exciting world of post-quantum cryptography and cybersecurity.

Ready to join the adventure? Apply now!

postings.title: Talent Pool - Join us at CryptoNext Security
postings.description:
Who we are

At CryptoNext Security, we are shaping the future of cybersecurity with post-quantum cryptography solutions. As a software vendors, our mission is to protect the critical data of the world’s largest enterprises and governments against emerging threats from quantum computers. Recognized as leaders in our field, we collaborate with organizations like banks, security institutions, and government entities to deploy CryptoNext’s solutions through cutting-edge technology projects. If you want to be at the heart of innovation and contribute to making the world safer, CryptoNext is the perfect place to enhance your skills.

As a rapidly growing company, we’re always on the lookout for forward-thinking individuals who bring fresh perspectives, deep technical expertise, and a passion for cybersecurity. CryptoNext is a dynamic workplace where talent meets opportunity, and we're building a pipeline of skilled, motivated professionals who may not see their perfect role advertised today but believe they can make a significant impact on our journey.

Areas of Interest:

We encourage speculative applications from talented individuals in the following domains:

- Cryptography & Research: Deep expertise in post-quantum cryptography, cryptographic protocols, algorithm design, and side-channel analysis.
- Software & Embedded Development: Skills in low-level software development, secure boot, protocols, HSMs, and tools like mbedTLS and cross-compilers.
We are also looking for seasoned developers who are skilled about software architecture.
- Project Management & Service Delivery: Experience in managing technical deployments in complex client environments, ideally with a focus on security and cryptography.
- Product & Innovation: Enthusiasm for building products that meet real-world challenges, along with a flair for product strategy and user experience.
- Sales & Marketing for Cybersecurity: A knack for translating technical innovations into value for clients and a passion for building relationships in high-tech sectors.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit?

Passionate: You’re excited about post-quantum cryptography and cybersecurity innovation.

- Forward-thinking: You anticipate challenges and are eager to tackle the unknown.
- Autonomous & Team Player: You thrive both independently and collaboratively, adaptable to changing dynamics and complex project requirements.
- Mission-Driven: You want to be part of something bigger and help build solutions that make a real difference in the world.

Benefits

CryptoNext offers a stimulating work environment where innovation and expertise come together to tackle tomorrow’s technological challenges.

On the benefits side, you’ll find a nice office located close to Gare de Lyon, a fair compensation package, and mainly… we believe here at CryptoNext that our coworkers are our best perks!

When it comes to remote work, we work from the office 3 days per week, at least.
